description: The current official MM dataset, universe, license and additional Coding Procedure remain unverified. The manual was read remotely; protocol deviations are preserved.
required_followup: Coordinator must verify the official baseline and original episode rules before export.

description: The 49 open-web queries cover English, French and Arabic, with weekly and sector probes. Search date operators returned wrong years. No LexisNexis-equivalent archive was available and the month is not claimed exhaustive.
required_followup: Extend discovery through controlled, dated newspaper archives and review access failures.

description: Many contemporary local PDFs and pages failed to open. Indexed descriptions remain discovery evidence; source-only candidates cannot be approved from snippets.
required_followup: Open lawful full original articles and newspaper PDFs; check printed dates, images and column layout. Do not bypass paywalls.

description: Algeria-Watch republications share El Watan origins; January 12, January 30 and February 15 accounts share an author. TSA forum and archive copies share TSA. ENIEM interview reports often share APS.
required_followup: Find independent original reporting and preserve syndication families; do not count mirrors as confirmations.

description: January 12 Ouargla and several campus or housing leads report dozens, which does not establish 50. Workforce totals, housing units and missing migrants are not crowd counts.
required_followup: Seek attributed attendance estimates or clear event-specific visual or written evidence.

description: The early Ouargla article literally says Tuesday, December 12; the January 31 account explicitly says the first action was January 12. Ownership provisionally relies on that later chronology without silently repairing the first article.
required_followup: Inspect the original El Watan January 13 printed edition and an independent January 12 report.

description: Ouargla January 12 and January 30 are called first and second actions, followed by a planned third in February. Separate candidates share an episode key. Continuous assembly or joint organization with Laghouat has not been established.
required_followup: Coordinator should apply additional episode rules after source review and document any merger.

description: Jijel begins January 30. Reports describe two versus three consecutive nights. No physical end is verified, and February easing does not establish the last protest day.
required_followup: Recover January 31–February 3 originals; clarify each night and continuous versus repeated actions while preserving January ownership.

description: Physical ends remain unknown. State responses remain unknown except attributed Jijel easing. Unreported reaction does not mean ignore; no shootings or deaths are inferred.
required_followup: Seek event-specific response and physical-closure evidence; retain unknown where absent.

description: Condor, health and ENIEM work stoppages and the Amizour housing claim need evidence of public assembly and a domestic state-policy target. Private disputes or public ownership alone are insufficient.
required_followup: Verify public action location and crowd size, plus an explicit government or policy demand; retain pending status or exclude with evidence.

description: ENIEM strike-start descriptions conflict: February 2020, December 1 or January 3. A December 26 public march is explicitly reported. January dispute continuity does not prove continuous public assembly.
required_followup: Recover December accounts and actual February return reports; distinguish workplace shutdown, strike and street march.

description: Béjaïa hall operators gathered January 13 and again January 27; alcohol retailers gathered January 13 after earlier actions. Shared campaign identity does not authorize automatic merger.
required_followup: Verify earlier actions and original episode criteria before deciding ownership or merger.

description: The campus protest report names Tayeb Bouzid, while university records identify the January 25 visitor as Abdelbaki Benziane.
required_followup: Open the report and video and verify identity; do not repeat the conflicting name as established fact.

description: Arabic queries were attempted, but two local Arabic leads need competent independent text review. Tamazight slogans are accessed through French reports; regional Arabic coverage is limited.
required_followup: Review Arabic originals independently and extend regional Arabic and Tamazight searches.

description: The January 24 seven-wilaya survey remains inaccessible. One unresolved discovery container is retained instead of inventing six locations or a nationally organized event.
required_followup: Recover the original Maghreb Emergent report, then create separate local records supported by evidence.

description: The January 3 families article says only previous week. December versus January ownership remains unresolved. The 23 missing migrants are not an attendance estimate.
required_followup: Recover the exact sit-in date and actual crowd estimate before transferring to the correct unit.

description: The Oran January 17 action is a conditional announcement, not verified occurrence. Three earlier protests are mentioned without dates.
required_followup: Find January 17–18 reporting or an explicit cancellation or payment report.

description: A February 3 secondary analysis mentions a recent Sonatrach headquarters attack. Its date, nature, participants and protest demand are unverified.
required_followup: Search original January or early-February reporting; do not code an attack as a protest without inclusion evidence.

description: January Hirak searches often return January 2020 marches and February 2021 relaunch reporting. No claim is made that January 2021 national Hirak actions did not occur.
required_followup: Check January 2021 archives with year headings; avoid importing wrong-year arrests or campaign attendance.
